Hi all —

Thanks for the intro, Daniel. Marissa — welcome. Below is our standard vendor onboarding checklist and timing expectations: 

Vendor onboarding requirements:
- Completed vendor information form (legal name, tax ID, address)
- W-9 (for US vendors) or equivalent tax docs
- Certificate of insurance (COI)
- SOC 2 Type II report (or equivalent security attestation)
- Standard vendor agreement — we’ll share redlines through legal
- Banking details for ACH payments

Timeline: 2–4 weeks for paperwork + legal review; PO issuance typically follows approval and can take up to 7 business days after approval. If a SOC2 review or third-party validation is needed, add 1–2 weeks.

Ask from our side:
- Estimated first-year spend number to route to finance (ballpark is fine).
- Pricing/pricing sheet and a short SOW if there are any custom integration services.

I’ve attached our vendor onboarding checklist for you to complete. Once we receive the docs we’ll route to legal/finance for review.

Thanks —
Priya Kaul
